decisions.reason: The corridor concern is a separate clause already represented by its own same-message INTRODUCE; removing the purple counter-side walls does not change the corridor requirement state.
Removing the marked partition walls does not alter the required dwelling count or Unit 1 configuration.
The source does not change allocation of the WC area to Unit 1 or the common-vestibule context.
Although the source mentions a counter side, it does not identify Unit 3 or necessarily change its cabinet dimensions, open-kitchen concept, counter placement, or bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The partition-wall change does not alter the common entrance location or the independent unit-door requirement.
The source does not identify Unit 1 or necessarily modify its open-kitchen configuration, cabinet positioning, or cabinet lengths.
Removing the purple walls does not change the specified bathroom-door position or the requirement that the door not obstruct the kitchen counter.
The wall-removal decision does not change the inclusion or Unit 1 assignment of the common bathroom area.
The sketch must still show separation walls and the dwelling division; a change to particular walls does not alter the artifact type, purpose, or required-content categories.
The source does not identify Unit 2 or necessarily change its cabinet-position requirement, open-kitchen concept, or cabinet dimensions.
The counter-side wall removal does not change Unit 2's bathroom requirement, bathroom position expectation, or centered-door specification.
The partition-wall decision does not alter the requirement to align bathroom and toilet positions with existing drains.
